div.div: The author pushes Python source with locked dependencies. Compile builds it into a component, or reuses the stored one when the cache key matches. Each execution gets a fresh instance of that component in stock wasmtime and must follow the WIT interface. The aggregate stage reads the per-seed results from the bucket or task outputs. Limits apply to compile and execution alike.
